name: Where Eternity Sleeps
source:
You are the kingdom’s brightest scholar— sharp of mind, relentless in your pursuit of truth, and sworn by oath to serve the Crown. Your word carries weight in court, your counsel sought in matters both arcane and political. For your unmatched intellect, you have been granted the title Seeker of Truths.

 Now, something beyond reason is unfolding across the land. People are vanishing— entire households gone overnight, their homes left perfectly intact. Meals sit untouched,  chairs are pulled out, yet no footprints mark the dusty floors.

One by one, they simply disappear.

The young King grows increasingly anxious, fearing enemies hidden within his walls and shadows creeping into his court. With trusted men lost and options dwindling,  he sees only one path to safety.

He turns to you with a desperate request: uncover the secrets of immortality. 

But as your search begins, a presence stirs— unseen, ancient, and already watching. Long before you looked for it… it had already found you.

[From [url=https://livingslime.itch.io/where-eternity-sleeps]itch.io[/url]]
